theorem backend.WBuf.reset_seq_lookup (W : backend.WBuf) (id : w64) : W.reset.seq !! id = Option.map

theorem backend.reset_step {W : backend.WBuf} {m' m'' : GMap w64 Bool} {pre : List w64} {key : w64}
    (Hm' : ∀ (id : w64), m' !! id = if id ∈ pre then W.reset.seq !! id else W.seq !! id) (Hkey : m''
    !! key = W.reset.seq !! key) (Hne : ∀ (id : w64), id ≠ key → m'' !! id = m' !! id) (id : w64) :
    m'' !! id = if id ∈ pre ++ [key] then W.reset.seq !! id else W.seq !! id
